title: Golden Cauliflower Cheese
summary: Boiled cauliflower florets baked in a mustard-spiked Cheddar sauce with more cheese on top until deep golden.

ingredients.note: about 900 g, cut into 4 cm florets

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water
unsalted butter, plus extra for the dish
fine sea salt or table salt
mature Cheddar, coarsely grated, for the top

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and butter the baking dish.

steps.title: Boil the cauliflower
steps.text: Bring the water and salt to the boil and cook the florets for 4-5 min, until a knife meets just a little resistance. Drain and leave them in the colander for a few minutes so the steam escapes; wet florets would thin the sauce. Arrange them rounded side up in the dish.

steps.title: Make the white sauce
steps.text: Melt the 40 g butter in the medium pan over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook 2 min without letting it colour. Off the heat, whisk in the milk a little at a time, then bring to the boil, whisking, and simmer for 5 min. Cooking the flour fully removes its raw taste and gives a smooth, thick sauce.

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.text: Take the sauce off the heat and whisk in the mustard powder, cayenne, nutmeg, 1/4 tsp salt and the 150 g Cheddar until melted and glossy. Keeping it off the heat stops the cheese turning stringy or greasy.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.text: Pour the sauce over the cauliflower, scatter over the 40 g Cheddar and bake for 20-25 min, until bubbling at the edges and deep golden on top. Rest for 5 min so the sauce settles before serving.

tips: Use a well-flavoured mature Cheddar; mild cheese gets lost in the sauce.
Do not overboil the cauliflower, as it softens further in the oven.
Mustard powder sharpens the cheese flavour without tasting of mustard.
Bake in individual dishes for a neat supper.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Reheat in a 180 °C (160 °C fan) oven, covered, for about 20 min until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
